get_lantern.title: The Last Lantern
get_lantern.active: Elder Oldrich is waiting by his house, near the square with the well.
get_lantern.done: Oldrich gave me the last lantern of the Quiet Ford.

light_beacon.title: The Beacon of the Quiet Ford
light_beacon.active: The beacon stands on the hill above the village. The road starts at the square. Keep to the light.
light_beacon.done: The beacon above the Ford is burning. People step onto their porches and look up.

lia_sun.title: What Is the Sun Like?
lia_sun.active: Lia has never seen the sun. She asks for even a tiny piece of light. Perhaps something near the beacon remembers the sun.
lia_sun.done: I brought Lia a primrose from the beacon. She drew me her sun.

mara_trade.title: Tea and Trade
mara_trade.active: Mara at the teahouse trades found things for oil, bread and herbs. People left many things by the roads and fences.
mara_trade.done: Mara and I traded. Her tea is as hot as ever.

borta_lantern.title: A Stronger Flame
borta_lantern.active: Borta the smith will make the lantern a bigger tank and a sturdier cap if I bring him copper wire. Mara sometimes has copper.
borta_lantern.done: Borta reforged my lantern. Now it burns longer and shines wider.

forest_beacon.title: The Beacon of the Whispering Wood
forest_beacon.active: Somewhere deep in the Whispering Wood a second beacon is hidden. The paths there lead in circles. Vale says the fireflies know the true way — the ones that fly, not the ones that circle.
forest_beacon.done: The beacon in the heart of the wood is burning. The wood remembered where its paths lead.

vale_mushrooms.title: Glowcaps for Vale
vale_mushrooms.active: Vale the herbalist asks for three glowcaps. They glow right beside the paths, where the earth remembers light.
vale_mushrooms.done: I brought Vale three glowcaps. He'll brew a draught for those who no longer dream in the dark.

swamp_beacon.title: The Beacon Above the Mire
swamp_beacon.active: The third beacon stands on an islet in the middle of the Mire, beyond a deep channel. You can't reach it on foot. Beware the lights over the bog: they look like a beacon, but they are marsh gas.
swamp_beacon.done: The beacon above the Mire is burning. The false lights have faded, and for the first time in years the water reflects the dawn.

ferry_fix.title: The Ferryman's Boat
ferry_fix.active: Korney the ferryman will take me across the channel if I help with his leaking boat. He needs rope for caulking — on the old boardwalk — and resin from the dead tree by the tussocks. Be careful getting the resin: there's a bog nearby.
ferry_fix.done: Korney's boat floats again. He ferries me whenever I need.

mountain_beacon.title: The Beacon Above the Observatory
mountain_beacon.active: The fourth beacon is on a crag by the mountain observatory, in the west. The stairs wind up the slope. The cold kills the lantern: light the braziers on the way and warm yourself by the fire.
mountain_beacon.done: The beacon on the crag is burning. A warm wind from the mountains drives the smoke away for the first time in years.

ansar_pages.title: Ansar's Star Charts
ansar_pages.active: The icy wind scattered three sheets of the scholar Ansar's star charts down the stairs. He asks me to gather them — without them his records are incomplete.
ansar_pages.done: I returned Ansar's star charts. He told me the truth about the Pall.

castle.title: The Castle Ruins
castle.active: Four beacons are burning. The portcullis on the bridge to the south has risen. In the castle ruins, in the throne hall, the king is waiting — and the last fire.

castle_final.title: The Last Fire
castle_final.active: The fifth beacon stands in the castle courtyard. But first I must speak with the king.

village_lamps.title: The Lamps of Quiet Ford
village_lamps.active: The street lamps of the Ford went out many years ago. A lamplighter knows what to do: light each one (E by the post). A lit lamp also shelters you from a wave of the Pall.
village_lamps.done: All seven lamps of Quiet Ford burn again. Someone left a flask of oil on the doorstep — without a note.

lia_lamb.title: Little Star
lia_lamb.active: Lia's lamb Little Star, the one with a white spot on her forehead, has run away. Lia heard her bleating somewhere to the north, by the road to the forest. Find her (E — call) and bring her back to the pen.
lia_lamb.done: Little Star is back in the pen. Lia gave me the scarf she was knitting for her father: "He doesn't need it yet, and you're cold in the mountains."

mara_bread.title: Bread for Korney
mara_bread.active: Mara baked a flatbread for Korney the ferryman — he lives alone in the Mire and hasn't been to the Ford in years. Take it to him while it's warm.
mara_bread.done: Korney held the bread for a long time, as if warming his hands. Then he gave me oil from his own store.

borta_herbs.title: Burned Hands
borta_herbs.active: Borta burned his hands at the forge, but he won't say a word. Vale in the forest knows how to make a salve — he needs four stalks of moonwort. It glows with a pale blue light in open places on the island.
borta_herbs.done: Vale's salve helped. Borta forged a wind hood for my lantern: now a wave of the Pall barely dims the flame.

post_letters.title: Letters Without a Courier
post_letters.active: A courier's bag lay at the foot of the mountains: the wind scattered his road long ago. Inside are three letters — for Mara, Borta and Lia. They have waited twenty years.
post_letters.done: All three letters have arrived. The courier never came back, but I finished his road.

warm_road.title: The Warm Road
warm_road.active: Five old braziers stand along the mountain stairway. If all of them are lit, the warmth will stay in the stone.
warm_road.done: All five braziers are burning. The stone of the stairway has warmed — the cold on the mountain is not so cruel now.
